name: skim-semantic-fresh-heldout-2026-09-24
purpose: Fresh acceptance corpus collected after pair-verification prompt was frozen. No model inference or prompt tuning performed by corpus researcher.
provenance_notes: Eight public historical reports from2021–2024 on entirely different specific events from the prior corpus. Small deliberately selected sample, not representative live news.
Heldout means new to this engineering evaluation; historical material may have appeared in model pretraining. No claim of unseen pretraining content.
Excerpts are short researcher paraphrases. German Commission headline retained; excerpt translated into English, which may simplify source language.
All retained citation pages opened successfully and facts/dates checked. FDA accelerated item is a section from an official archived bulletin; main linked release did not load.
Original source publication dates and event dates retained. Euronews has a next-day update; Nintendo reports an announcement in July of planned October availability.
Axios headline-plus-excerpt totals remain under25words per page. No private feeds, app database, credentials, model calls or production edits.
Expected groups, negatives, importance, provenance and inference notes must stay out of model inputs. Only allowlisted article fields should be supplied.

evaluation_protocol.clustering_unit: Same specific occurrence or decision; related legislative stages and regulatory pathways remain separate.
evaluation_protocol.ranking: General-interest public consequence at the time of each event. Disable/equalize recency and personal preferences while preserving dates for event identity.

articles.title: EU schafft Blaupause für vertrauenswürdige KI in der ganzen Welt
articles.excerpt: European Parliament members approved the AI Act by 523 votes to 46, with 49 abstentions. The measure regulates AI according to risk. Formal Council endorsement was still required.
articles.verification: Opened German Commission page; checked March13 publication and parliamentary vote, including Council endorsement still pending. English excerpt translated/paraphrased.

articles.title: Lawmakers approve AI Act with overwhelming majority
articles.excerpt: The European Parliament voted overwhelmingly for rules imposing obligations on AI systems according to their risks. The tally was 523 in favour, 46 against and 49 abstentions.
articles.verification: Opened page; original publication March13, updated March14. Checked vote and institution; original publication date retained.

articles.title: FDA Converts Novel Alzheimer’s Disease Treatment to Traditional Approval
articles.excerpt: FDA converted Leqembi from accelerated to traditional approval after a confirmatory study demonstrated clinical benefit for Alzheimer’s disease. The agency had previously cleared the treatment through the accelerated pathway.
articles.verification: Opened source page and checked publication date and described action.

articles.title: FDA approves first drug to slow Alzheimer's progression
articles.excerpt: Leqembi received full FDA approval, opening a path to broader insurance coverage.
articles.verification: Opened source page and checked publication date and described action.

articles.title: Nintendo announces Nintendo Switch OLED Model with a vibrant 7-inch OLED screen launching Oct 8
articles.excerpt: Nintendo announced a Switch model with a larger OLED display, more storage and an improved stand. The company scheduled October 8 availability at a suggested $349.99 price.
articles.verification: Opened source page and checked publication date and described action.

articles.title: Nintendo Switch OLED coming this October
articles.excerpt: Nintendo unveiled an OLED Switch with expanded storage and an adjustable stand.
articles.verification: Opened source page and checked publication date and described action.

articles.title: Artificial intelligence (AI) act: Council gives final green light to the first worldwide rules on AI
articles.excerpt: The Council formally approved the AI Act, including risk-based obligations and prohibited uses. Signature and official publication were the next steps before entry into force.
articles.verification: Opened source page and checked publication date and described action.

articles.title: FDA Grants Accelerated Approval for Alzheimer’s Disease Treatment
articles.excerpt: FDA approved Leqembi through its accelerated approval pathway for Alzheimer’s disease. The announcement described a medicine targeting the disease’s underlying biology.
articles.verification: Opened official FDA bulletin dated January6 at14:45EST; title is the news-release section heading, not the full bulletin title. Original linked FDA release did not load; bulletin is accessible primary evidence.

expected_groups.reason: Both report the same European Parliament vote, with identical tally and subject; Commission reaction is accompanying coverage.
Same FDA conversion to traditional approval after clinical-benefit confirmation.
Same model announcement and announced future availability, not an October launch-day event.
Separate formal decision by the Council, another required legislative actor, rather than the earlier Parliament vote.
Earlier accelerated authorization is a different regulatory action and evidence standard from conversion to traditional approval.

expected_importance.status: Human editorial inference, not source fact or universal personal preference.

strict_acceptance_constraints.reason: Broad legal-rights or disease-treatment decisions outweigh a consumer-console hardware refresh for a general-interest reader.

expected_importance.caveat: Relative importance among health and regulation is debatable; only the broad major-versus-consumer-refresh constraint is scored.

label_status: All group, negative-pair and importance labels are manually reasoned judgments. Broad continuing-story clustering could combine legislative stages or drug approvals; labels explicitly use separate specific decisions. Distinctions rely on actor/action/legal pathway, not dates alone.
